modelingNotes: Thirsty Beaver Saloon, 1225 Central Avenue, Plaza Midwood, Charlotte — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-thirsty-beaver.ts

The one-storey honky-tonk (opened 2008) whose landlord would not sell, so the Overton Row apartments (2018-2025) were built round it in a horseshoe. A plain flat-roofed box of buff brick, about 6.5 × 18 m, end-on to Central Avenue. What makes it itself, each drawn as plain geometry: - the street front: buff brick, a dark wooden fascia over a silver flashing strip, the big yellow "Thirsty Beaver Saloon" board centred over the door (lettering and shamrock not modelled; the board's colour is), the door and two barred windows either side; - the east flank painted orange, with the beaver mural near the front corner: a brown beaver in a white cowboy hat and boots, one paw raised, a menu in the other, a big dark tail behind (flat shapes on the wall); - the roof stepping down a little halfway back.

Map frame: x across the front (east +), y back from Central Avenue (bearing 10.4, the outline's long axis), z up, metres. The front faces Central Avenue at 190°. Origin = centroid of OSM way/323198175, lng -80.8173163, lat 35.2213364.

Evidence: - OSM way/323198175 (name, wikidata Q123524350, no height): 6.47 × 18.38 m. - Lidar, USGS 3DEP USGS_LPC_NC_Phase4_Mecklenburg_2016 (flown 2016-17), 0.5 m grid sampled in this frame: footprint 6 × 19 m, about 0.5 m east and 1.3 m south of the OSM outline (OSM kept, it is what the map hides); roof 5.3 m above ground_min (213.89 m) over the front half and 4.5 m over the back half, the step about midway; ground 0.8-1.2 m on the west side, 1.7-1.8 m on the east and at the front. y = 0 is ground_min + 1.1 m (the west side). - Published: Wikipedia "Thirsty Beaver" — one storey, 1,200 sq ft (111 m²; the outline is 119 m²), opened 2008; "on an orange side of the building is a large beaver ... wearing a cowboy hat and boots". - Photos (Wikimedia Commons): · "Thirsty beaver.jpg", David D'Agostino, CC BY-SA 4.0 — the front head-on from the patio: the layout of the front, measured on it at 6.47 m wide (102 px/m). https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Thirsty_beaver.jpg · "Side view of the Thirsty Beaver.jpg" and "The Thirsty Beaver.jpg", David D'Agostino, CC BY-SA 4.0 — front and the orange east flank from the south-east; the mural's height and position. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Side_view_of_the_Thirsty_Beaver.jpg https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Thirsty_Beaver.jpg · "The Thirsty Beaver in Charlotte North Carolina.jpg", John F. Roberts, 2018, public domain — the front from across Central Avenue. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Thirsty_Beaver_in_Charlotte_North_Carolina.jpg · "Thirsty beaver sign.jpg", David D'Agostino, CC BY-SA 4.0 — the board's colour. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Thirsty_beaver_sign.jpg · "Overton Row surrounding Thirsty Beaver Early April 2025.jpg", City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0 — the front from across Central Avenue in daylight, its height against the apartments. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Overton_Row_surrounding_Thirsty_Beaver_Early_April_2025.jpg - USGS NAIP: the roof is pale grey (too coarse for more at this size).

Numbers: plan from OSM; roof levels and the step from lidar, the front raised 0.2 m to the photo's 3.9 m wall over the front pavement (measured on the head-on photo against the 6.47 m width; lidar gives 3.5 m, its roof returns sit behind the fascia). Openings, board, fascia and flashing measured on the head-on photo. The mural: its height (hat 4.0 m, boots 1.35 m) from the south-east photo; its width from the beaver's own proportions, the flank being too foreshortened to measure; its place, centred 1.9 m behind the front corner, estimated from the same photo.

Doubts: no photo shows the west wall, the back or the rear 15 m of the east flank (the apartments stand within a few metres). The whole east flank is painted orange here; only its front 3-4 m is photographed. The west wall and back are drawn as plain buff brick.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-thirsty-beaver", model "clt-thirsty-beaver"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/a1974bbf738c6994edbe99a7a61818b9d69da9e0/generators/clt-thirsty-beaver.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
